sources.title: Independent score-margin calculation
sources.details: Error vector=(0.01,0); candidate-axis mean=(0.01+0)/2=0.005 in arbitrary score units. Original margin for 貓 over EOS is 0.005, EOS perturbation is 0.01 so rank flips; if second score is 2, margin is 1, preserving both choices at the same MAE. Float32 expected MAE 0.004999995231628418 and float64 0.0050000000000000044; abs tolerance 1e-8 against decimal 0.005.
